notes.title: Recoil Attachments & Hand Menu
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620242/c19a74ea79db4f3b490cb2508f9be320ea2f5426.png[/img]

[b]Current Update 6.5[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Physics Recoil System
[*] Fixed TTK Reset to not impact TTK score which would result in review error.
[*] Fixed TTK to function smoother.
[*] Hand Menu has been revamped and added back
[*] Hand Menu now switched on relative to where the player is looking
[*] Hand Menu to include back & skip button for songs.
[*] Hand Menu to include task timer.
[*] Hand Menu to include song and artist name.
[*] Moved Silencer on 9MM to not clip with front sight
[/list]

[b]OLDER UPDATES:[/b]

[b]Patch 6.4[/b]

[list]
[*] More music has been added into the Music Player.
[*] Old Attachment system and weapon selection has been revamped and is easier to work with.
[*] 3 New sights have been added.
[*] Pistols can have an silencer attachment.
[*] Lasers have been added to attachments.
[*] Temporarily removed the M4.
[/list]

[b]Patch 6.3[/b]

[list]
[*] Pitch and Yaw issue is now fixed on most controllers (please report any issues in the discord)
[*] As a result the pitch panel has been removed from settings but is getting revamped and will come back.
[*] Rifles have been added however, a better virtual stock is needed.
[*] You can add sights to rifles.
[*] Barrier has been added to Gridshots.
[*] Getting out of the map on specific maps have been fixed.
[*] Added titles to Menu buttons to be more descriptive.
[*] Bad marks now have a TV demo to help explain what they mean.
[*] Panic Flick no longer gets stuck on 0.00 seconds.
[*] TV has been moved to be in peripheral while in the Menu.
[*] New AI that shoot back have been slowly added with 2 new maps.
[*] Started to replace the old AI with the new ones - hint why Multi Task is gone.
[*] TTK (Time to Kill) has been completely revamped and works better than the previous.
[*] The Review system now can detect the new TTK and give out more accurate task results.
[*] The Review system has been updated for TTK to be faster than previously needed to be considered a good or bad task completion.
[*] The Review system now shows location based damage for the NEW AI when the appropriate task has been used.
[*] The Review system will now have a second page giving a detailed description on your results. (A third page will be added)
[*] Added in Discord Requirement for specific menu options ONLY for playtest phase.
[*] IK System now uses a more fitting character.
[*] Fixed issue that stopped players from loading into the game.
[*] Fixed issue with Save now being overwritten.
[*] And many more fixes and issues have been patched.
[*] Known Issues:
[*] Hand Placement on pistols looks a little weird
[/list]

[b]Patch 6.3-b[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue were players could not load into the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing Workstation and Sights!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44645924/dced2f9233ad1af972b13ca9702504417acddd35.png[/img]

[i]This update comes with a lot of bug fixes, a lot of issues fixed that remained prevalent, new content, quality life changes and more.
There are a few issues still that reside in this patch but will be fixed shortly in a few days. [/i]

[b]Update changes in 6.0[/b]

New sight introduced: reflex sights.

Added workshop station to add and remove sights to your weapon.

Updated the grabbing pose while grabbing the 9mm slide, accommodating other weapon sights.

Made pitch easier to change, no more accidently flipping the slider all the way up or down!

Added manual save option in the menu.

Pitch will no longer reset itself.

Added a better singleton to Custom Music to stop the chances of duplication.

Arranged how managers are destroyed and scenes are saved.

Fixed player not loading Post Processing in specific scenes.

Menu Target model is updated to stop confusion between a regular target.

Menu Target now needs to be shot twice to confirm the need to return to Menu preventing mishaps.

Made projectiles feel more responsive.

Shadows darkened from .84 to .4 to look more moodier

Added glass to the preview case in the shop.

Accuracy can now only be determined as absolute making large negative numbers impossible.

Made skyboxes settings in the menu work again and removed redundant code slowing it down.

Audio from the TV now plays from the direction of the TV and the volume can be controlled via SFX.

Fixed not displaying proper weakness outputs in the review scene.

Edited the weakness outputs in the review scene.

Changed timestep from 0.0138 to 0.01

Raised the Fail Safe Boundaries

Updated TV to look more like static

Removed dirt mound in Gridshot Regular.

[u][i]Known Issues:[/i][/u]
[i]Player may sometimes fall under the map (You will respawn to a safe position)

Version number is still 5.9 and not 6.0 (Forgot to update this)

Graph isn't properly displaying information at the moment (Comes with how I edited Singletons in this patch)[/i]
